title: Print-and-play night
desc: Print a free print-and-play game, sleeve the cards with old playing cards behind them, and try it before buying anything.

title: Custom box insert
needs: Foam core and glue, or a 3D printer
desc: Measure a game box and build trays so setup takes two minutes instead of ten.

title: Design an 18-card microgame
desc: Limit yourself to 18 cards. Playtest with blank cards first and change one rule at a time.

title: Score tracker web page
needs: HTML, a little JavaScript or Python
desc: Build a simple score pad for a favourite game that adds up totals and remembers past games.

title: Dice probability explorer
desc: Simulate thousands of rolls to see why 7 is the most common total of two dice, then test the odds in a game you own.

title: Design a roll-and-write
desc: Design a game that fits on one sheet and plays with two dice. Test it at the next game night.

title: Where do you land in Monopoly?
desc: Simulate a million turns and find which squares get landed on most. Jail changes everything.

title: House rules booklet
desc: Write down the house rules your group actually uses and print them as a small booklet.

title: Game night log
desc: Record who played what and who won. After a few months, chart the standings.

title: Dice tower
desc: Build a tower with baffles inside that tumbles the dice into a tray.

title: Redesign a player aid
desc: Take the game your group finds hardest to remember and fit a turn summary on one card.

title: Write a solo variant
needs: A game you own, index cards
desc: Invent an automatic opponent driven by a small deck of cards, and play against it.

title: Unbeatable noughts and crosses
desc: Write a minimax player that never loses, then make it explain each move.

title: Custom meeples
desc: Replace the plain pieces in a favourite game with ones that fit its theme.

title: Card game from a spreadsheet
desc: Generate a deck of printable cards from a spreadsheet, so rebalancing takes one edit.

title: Five-minute teach
desc: Write and rehearse a script that teaches a game in five minutes. Harder than it sounds.

title: How many shuffles?
desc: Simulate riffle shuffles and measure how many it takes to mix a deck properly.

title: Make an ancient game
desc: Build a board for the Royal Game of Ur or Hnefatafl and learn the reconstructed rules.

title: Campaign journal
desc: Keep an in-character diary of a campaign or legacy game. It is fun to read back a year later.

title: Connect Four bot
desc: Write a player that looks several moves ahead with alpha-beta pruning, and try to beat it.
